name: lnsat
description: Pre-release source for policy-governed AI-agent authorization, human approval, and audit evidence

scripts.build:contracts: npm run build -w @lnsat/packets && npm run build -w @lnsat/policy && npm run build -w @lnsat/audit && npm run build -w @lnsat/gateway
scripts.check: npm run public:check && npm run audit:dependencies:test && npm run docs:direction:check && npm run legacy:inventory:check && npm run audit:migrations:check && npm run security:conformance:check && npm run phase7d:truth:check && npm run phase7:local-conformance:test && npm run phase7:local-conformance:check && npm run security:review:test && npm run security:review:check && npm run phase7:readiness:test && npm run phase7:readiness:check && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run test:workspaces && npm run rust:check
scripts.fastmcp:3:interop: npm run build -w @lnsat/mcp && npm run mcp:oauth-security:test && node scripts/run-fastmcp-interop.mjs 3-legacy
scripts.fastmcp:4:interop: npm run build -w @lnsat/mcp && npm run mcp:oauth-security:test && node scripts/run-fastmcp-interop.mjs 4-modern
scripts.identity:observability:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/gateway && npm run test:identity-observability -w @lnsat/gateway
scripts.a2a:contract:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/gateway && npm run test:a2a-contract -w @lnsat/gateway
scripts.source:check: npm run format:check && npm run check && npm run release:metadata:check && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run security:review:supported-release-check && npm run source:check
scripts.mcp:negotiation:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/mcp && npm run test:negotiation -w @lnsat/mcp
scripts.mcp:official-conformance: npm run build -w @lnsat/mcp && node scripts/run-mcp-official-conformance.mjs && npm run test:official-conformance -w @lnsat/mcp
scripts.mcp:oauth-security:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/mcp && npm run test:oauth-security -w @lnsat/mcp
scripts.mcp:schema-security:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/mcp && npm run test:schema-security -w @lnsat/mcp
scripts.operation:recovery:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/gateway && npm run test:operation-recovery -w @lnsat/gateway
scripts.registry:supply-chain:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/gateway && npm run test:registry-supply-chain -w @lnsat/gateway
scripts.signer:provider:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/policy && npm run test:signer-provider -w @lnsat/policy
scripts.control-center:readback:test: npm run build -w @lnsat/gateway && npm run test:control-center-readback -w @lnsat/gateway && npm run test:operation-readback -w @lnsat/api && npm run test:operation-readback -w @lnsat/console
scripts.rust:conformance: npm run build:contracts && node scripts/rust-contract-conformance.mjs && npm run rust:test
scripts.rust:check: npm run rust:format:check && npm run rust:lint && npm run rust:conformance && npm run rust:metadata
scripts.test:workspaces: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck:workspaces: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
